info.name: iNat API — WEB-1060 lifelist endpoints
info.description: Requests for the lifelist-related endpoints added in WEB-1060 (observations/taxa, observations/taxonomy, taxa/lifelist_metadata). Import into the iNaturalist `API` collection, or merge the v1/v2 folders into it. Requests carry no auth so they inherit the collection's; `{{base_url}}` is an origin with no version segment.

request.description:
`GET /v1/observations/taxa` — ObservationsController.taxa (lib/controllers/v1/observations_controller.js).

Aggregates matching observations by `taxon.id` and returns `{ taxon_id, count }` pairs.

- `user_id` is REQUIRED — omitting it returns 422 (verified against the running API).
- Accepts the full observation search parameter set (the query is passed straight to
  `ObservationsController.elasticResults`).
- NOT paginated. The controller forces `per_page: 0` and reports
  `page: 1, per_page: <number of buckets>`; the terms agg is capped at size 700000.
- No `setTTL` / `defaultTTL` on the v1 route.

request.description:
`GET /v1/observations/taxonomy` — ObservationsController.taxonomy.

Returns every taxon in the ancestry of matching observations with
`descendant_obs_count` / `direct_obs_count`, plus `count_without_taxon`.

- NO required params — an unfiltered call scans the whole index, so always filter
  (e.g. `user_id`).
- `count_without_taxon` is only computed when `taxon_id` is NOT supplied; it costs a
  second ES query.
- NOT paginated. v1 returns `{ count_without_taxon, size, results }` — note `size`,
  not `page`/`per_page`.
- Route option `defaultTTL: 300`.

`GET /v1/taxa/lifelist_metadata` — TaxaController.lifelistMetadata.

Returns the taxon name / common name / default photo for every taxon the user has
observed (via `ESModel.userObservedTaxonIDsCached`).

- `observed_by_user_id` is REQUIRED; it is resolved through
  `User.findByLoginOrID` (lib/api_util.js), so a **login** works as well as a numeric id
  — `observed_by_user_id=tonyrebelo` returns 200 (verified).
- Missing/unknown user -> `throw new Error( 422 )`. Empty observed-taxon set ->
  `throw new Error( 500 )`. The sentinel `[-1]` returns `{}`.
- NOT paginated — v1 returns `{ total_results, results }` with no page/per_page.
- Route option `defaultTTL: 300`.

request.description:
`GET /v2/observations/taxa` — openapi/paths/v2/observations/taxa.js
delegates directly to v1 `ObservationsController.taxa` (no v2 wrapper method).

Documented params = openapi/schema/request/observations_taxa.js, which is
observations_search with `user_id` made REQUIRED.

- `x-default-ttl: 300`.
- Response schema `ResultsObservationsTaxa` is `unknown( false )` — only
  `total_results`, `page`, `per_page`, `results[{ taxon_id, count }]`.
- Send `fields` or the response comes back sparse.
- NOT paginated (see the v1 request).

request.description:
`GET /v2/observations/taxonomy` — openapi/paths/v2/observations/taxonomy.js
calls v2 `ObservationsController.taxonomy`, which wraps v1 and re-shapes the envelope to
`{ page: 1, per_page: results.length, total_results: results.length, count_without_taxon, results }`
(the v1 `size` key is dropped).

- Documented params = the full observations_search schema; nothing is required.
- `x-default-ttl: 300` and **`x-unpublished: true`** — this endpoint is deliberately
  hidden from the published API docs.
- Response schema `ResultsObservationsTaxonomy` is `unknown( false )`; each result is
  limited to id, name, rank, rank_level, is_active, iconic_taxon_name, parent_id,
  descendant_obs_count, direct_obs_count.
- NOT paginated.

`GET /v2/taxa/lifelist_metadata` — openapi/paths/v2/taxa/lifelist_metadata.js
calls v2 `TaxaController.lifelistMetadata`, which wraps v1 and adds the envelope
`{ page: 1, per_page: results.length, total_results: results.length, results }`.

- Documented params = openapi/schema/request/taxa_lifelist_metadata.js — a small,
  hand-written schema: `observed_by_user_id` (required, integer OR string login),
  `locale`, `preferred_place_id`, `fields`. This is the whole set; unlike the
  observations endpoints it does NOT accept the search schema.
- `x-default-ttl: 300`.
- Response schema `ResultsTaxaLifelistMetadata` is `unknown( false )` — results are
  limited to id, name, default_photo.medium_url, preferred_common_name.
- NOT paginated.
